parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: 'whatsapp', recipient_type: 'individual', to: $('Merge intake paths').first().json.phone, type: 'interactive', interactive: { type: 'button', body: { text: 'That time is booked. Pick one of these:' }, action: { buttons: (() => { const busy = ($json.busy || []).map(b => ({ s: Date.parse(b.start), e: Date.parse(b.end) })); const step = {{CONFIG.slot_step_minutes}} * 60000; const count = {{CONFIG.recovery_slot_count}}; const base = Date.parse($('Merge intake paths').first().json.start_at); const pad = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0'); const days = ['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat']; const out = []; let t = base; const limit = base + step * count * 2; while (out.length < count && t < limit) { if (!busy.some(b => t >= b.s && t < b.e)) { const d = new Date(t); out.push({ type: 'reply', reply: { id: 'SLOT_alt_' + d.toISOString() + '_' + $('Merge intake paths').first().json.booking_id, title: days[d.getDay()] + ' ' + pad(d.getHours()) + ':' + pad(d.getMinutes()) } }); } t += step; } return out; })() } } } }) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: 'whatsapp', recipient_type: 'individual', to: $('Select active booking').first().json.phone, type: 'interactive', interactive: { type: 'button', body: { text: 'Pick a new time:' }, action: { buttons: (() => { const busy = ($json.busy || []).map(b => ({ s: Date.parse(b.start), e: Date.parse(b.end) })); const step = {{CONFIG.slot_step_minutes}} * 60000; const count = {{CONFIG.recovery_slot_count}}; const base = Date.now(); const pad = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0'); const days = ['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat']; const out = []; let t = base - (base % step) + step; const limit = base + step * count * 2; while (out.length < count && t < limit) { if (!busy.some(b => t >= b.s && t < b.e)) { const d = new Date(t); out.push({ type: 'reply', reply: { id: 'SLOT_res_' + d.toISOString() + '_' + $('Select active booking').first().json.booking_id, title: days[d.getDay()] + ' ' + pad(d.getHours()) + ':' + pad(d.getMinutes()) } }); } t += step; } return out; })() } } } }) }}
